companies.name: Bio-Salud S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Health food wholesale: supplements, gluten-free foods, bulk goods, dried fruit, baking, vegan products, sweeteners and natural cosmetics.
companies.channels_supplied: Dietéticas and independent shops across Córdoba, with nationwide shipping; also advises new dietéticas on opening.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Happy Food alfajor sin azúcar, Kony Stevia Life and a stevia-sweetened Trini dulce de leche.
companies.fit_rationale: The best-matched specialist in the city: it already sells sugar-free and stevia lines into the dietética channel that suits Diablo's positioning. The Happy Food sugar-free alfajor overlaps with Diablo's biscuit and sweets range, so the pitch should lead with chocolate and spreads.
what_they_do_well: Runs an advisory service that helps clients open new dietéticas, building its own retail network.
Exhibited as a Córdoba wholesale distributor at the Expo Dieteticactiva trade show.

companies.name: El Mercadito Natural
companies.distributes: Health and natural foods, nuts, cereals, snack bars, sweeteners and dairy alternatives; retail-wholesale format.
companies.channels_supplied: Own chain of about 10 health stores in Córdoba plus a wholesale branch serving resellers, dietéticas and online shops in other cities and provinces.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Exclusive representative for Granix, Ceral, Cocoon, Kony and Trini, which include diet and stevia lines (2021 article; current status not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: Combines exclusive brand representation with its own retail chain, so it can both place and sell through a new range. Its brand portfolio is better-for-you but has no confirmed sugar-free chocolate, leaving room for Diablo.
what_they_do_well: Described in 2021 as the largest healthy-food chain in Córdoba, with 10 own branches.
Exclusive Córdoba representative for Granix, Ceral, Kony and Trini.

companies.name: Distrimay
companies.distributes: Natural and healthy foods, national and imported, over 2,000 items including vegan and gluten-free lines plus own repacked products.
companies.channels_supplied: Dietéticas, almacenes and direct consumers through three branches (Villa Carlos Paz and two in Córdoba Capital) and e-commerce.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Healthy, vegan and gluten-free lines; sugar-free brands not named on its site.
companies.fit_rationale: A family health-food wholesaler already handling imported products and supplying dietéticas around Córdoba and the Punilla tourist corridor. Diablo would add a sugar-free confectionery category it does not visibly offer.
what_they_do_well: Supplies dietéticas and almacenes from three branches across Villa Carlos Paz and Córdoba Capital.
Trading for over ten years with more than 2,000 products.

companies.name: Comer Sano Córdoba
companies.distributes: Own vegan foods plus third-party healthy products, imported or repacked almonds, coconut oil, granolas and cereals.
companies.channels_supplied: About 80 points of sale, mainly dietéticas and greengrocers in Córdoba Capital, plus Alta Gracia, Río Cuarto, Villa María and other provinces.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Third-party healthy brands such as Prama and Vita Biosa; no sugar-free confectionery confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: A small but active route into Córdoba dietéticas that already sells other makers' healthy brands. Fit depends on whether it can handle chocolate in warm months, which is not confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Reaches around 80 points of sale, mostly dietéticas in Córdoba Capital.

companies.name: Vendor Distribuciones
companies.distributes: Mass consumption foods, mainly dairy and chilled lines (Milkaut, Citric, Firenze, Don Yeyo, Campo Austral).
companies.channels_supplied: More than 4,600 shops and businesses across Córdoba province; online ordering for registered clients.
companies.fit_rationale: Its refrigerated fleet and temperature-controlled chamber solve the chocolate heat problem in Córdoba summers. Confectionery is not its core, so Diablo would be a new category.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 2003 with more than 4,600 clients in Córdoba province.
Runs 15 refrigerated vehicles and a 2,000 m3 temperature-controlled chamber.

companies.name: Golosh
companies.distributes: Confectionery, chocolates, alfajores and snacks, national and imported; over 500 products.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks, almacenes, maxikioscos and shops in Córdoba, with shipping across Argentina.
companies.fit_rationale: Already sells imported confectionery to kiosks, so a European sugar-free range fits its offer. No sugar-free line is visible, giving Diablo a clear gap.
what_they_do_well: Over 30 years in confectionery wholesale, selling national and imported sweets.

companies.name: Integrall Distribuidora
companies.distributes: Over 1,000 consumer goods: chocolates, confectionery, biscuits, ice cream, flours and gluten-free items.
companies.channels_supplied: More than 1,500 shops and kiosks in north-west Córdoba city, Villa Allende and Saldán.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Gluten-free range; no sugar-free brands named.
companies.fit_rationale: Established confectionery route with a gluten-free category that shows openness to free-from lines. Its Arcor focus may limit room for a rival chocolate brand.
what_they_do_well: Family distributor trading since 1978 with more than 1,500 retail clients.

companies.name: NutriDiet
companies.distributes: Dried fruit and nuts, flours, gluten-free items, supplements, sweeteners, oils, cereals and snack bars.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale price list for resellers and online retail from stalls in Mercado Norte, Córdoba.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sweetener and keto lines; brands carried include Granger, EntreNuts and Santa María.
companies.fit_rationale: A Mercado Norte health wholesaler with sweeteners and keto items already on offer, close to Diablo's buyer. Smaller scale than the tier 1 specialists.

companies.name: Nueva Era Mayorista
companies.distributes: High-volume wholesale of food, cleaning products and perfumery.
companies.channels_supplied: Cash and carry branches in Villa Carlos Paz, Oncativo and Río Cuarto serving shops and consumers.
companies.fit_rationale: Multi-branch regional wholesaler that would put Diablo in front of small shopkeepers across the province. Head office location and confectionery depth not verified.
what_they_do_well: Operates wholesale branches in Villa Carlos Paz, Oncativo and Río Cuarto.

companies.name: Juan José Morán
companies.distributes: Cigarettes and confectionery wholesale.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks and shops in Río Cuarto and the south of the province.
companies.fit_rationale: Covers the south of the province from Río Cuarto, a gap for the Córdoba Capital players. Tobacco-led, so a health range is a newer fit.

companies.name: Caterser Distribuidora
companies.distributes: Foodservice supplies: sweets and snacks, dairy, frozen, cold meats, grains, drinks and coffee.
companies.channels_supplied: Foodservice businesses in Córdoba, Alta Gracia, Villa Carlos Paz, Villa General Belgrano and the Sierras.
companies.fit_rationale: Could place Diablo syrups and sweets in cafés and hotels in the tourist sierras. Retail reach is limited.
what_they_do_well: Family business trading since 1995 with weekly deliveries across the Córdoba sierras.

companies.name: Distribuidora Arcor Córdoba Norte
companies.distributes: Arcor confectionery, chocolates, biscuits, ice cream and grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Shops across northern Córdoba via sales reps and merchandisers, plus the ArcorCenter outlet in Jesús María.
companies.fit_rationale: Strong field sales and cold chain but it describes itself as an exclusive Arcor distributor, which likely blocks a competing chocolate brand.
what_they_do_well: Over 20 years in the region with sales reps and a merchandising team visiting each point of sale.

companies.name: Distribuidora Pop
companies.distributes: Over 5,000 kiosk products: confectionery, biscuits, snacks, grocery, tobacco and bazaar.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks, almacenes and mini markets nationally, with a dedicated Córdoba wholesale page and shipping to the interior.
companies.sf_brands_carried: A healthy products section; no sugar-free brands named.
companies.fit_rationale: National online wholesaler actively targeting Córdoba kiosks. Not based locally, so it is a secondary route.

companies.name: Golosinas por Mayor (Alfacentauri S.R.L.)
companies.distributes: National and imported confectionery and kiosk products.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks, maxikioscos and drugstores in Córdoba province.
companies.fit_rationale: States it distributes imported confectionery wholesale in Córdoba province. Its base and scale are unverified.

companies.name: Almacén de Frutos
companies.distributes: Dried fruit, nuts, granolas, seeds, flours, sweeteners, healthy biscuits and chocolate-coated nuts.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale accounts for resellers and online retail in Córdoba Capital.
companies.fit_rationale: Small health wholesaler with a chocolate-coated range and sweeteners category. Córdoba base inferred from delivery terms, not stated.

companies.name: VITTA Productos Naturales
companies.distributes: Natural products: nuts, flours, teas, chocolates, snacks, bars, biscuits and gluten-free items.
companies.channels_supplied: Online shoppers and wholesale buyers in Río Cuarto.
companies.fit_rationale: A health store with a wholesale arm in the south of the province. Mainly retail, so distribution scale is limited.

companies.name: Pirani Distribuciones
companies.distributes: Food distribution (range not verified).
companies.channels_supplied: Trade in Río Cuarto and south Córdoba (not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: Appears as a Río Cuarto food distributor in search results but its site could not be read. Needs qualifying before outreach.

companies.name: Distribuidora Priotti
companies.distributes: Kiosk products, especially confectionery and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks in Villa Carlos Paz.
companies.fit_rationale: Local kiosk confectionery wholesaler in a major tourist town. Small and only directory-sourced.

companies.name: Digacor
companies.distributes: Food, disposables and cleaning products, wholesale and retail.
companies.channels_supplied: Families, almacenes, hotels, bars and restaurants in Villa Carlos Paz.
companies.fit_rationale: Serves hotels and almacenes in the Punilla tourist area. Generalist with no confectionery focus.

companies.name: Distribuidora Freyre
companies.distributes: Dry, fresh and frozen foods, wholesale only.
companies.channels_supplied: Trade customers around Villa Carlos Paz.
companies.fit_rationale: Wholesale-only food distributor with frozen capability. Fit for confectionery not established.

companies.name: Dulcar
companies.distributes: Confectionery wholesale.
companies.channels_supplied: Delivery to shops in several Córdoba neighbourhoods.
companies.fit_rationale: Small city confectionery wholesaler with home delivery. Directory-sourced only.

companies.name: Hai Golosinas
companies.distributes: Confectionery, wholesale and retail.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks and shoppers in Alta Gracia.
companies.fit_rationale: Local confectionery wholesaler south of Córdoba city. Directory-sourced only.

companies.name: Distribuidora Marengo
companies.distributes: Confectionery, wholesale and retail.
companies.channels_supplied: Shops in Villa María (not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: Listed among Córdoba confectionery wholesalers in Villa María. Directory-sourced only.

companies.name: Goodiet
companies.distributes: Peeled and washed vegetables, cereals, jams, spices, nuts, bakery supplies and seeds.
companies.channels_supplied: Restaurants, caterers, meal providers and health shops, with nationwide shipping.
companies.fit_rationale: Sells to dietéticas and foodservice from Córdoba, but its core is prepared vegetables. Low relevance unless it is expanding its dry range.

companies.name: La Granja del Centro
companies.distributes: Natural foods, sports nutrition, herbs, cereals and legumes, jams, nut butters, plant drinks, gluten-free snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale to dietéticas and distributors in Córdoba with shipping across Argentina.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Meriendita Light, Savona Fit, BIBA sugar-free almond drink; no direct sugar-free confectionery competitor seen.
companies.fit_rationale: A dietética wholesaler that represents manufacturers and already lists light and fit snack brands, but no sugar-free chocolate. Diablo would fill a clear gap in its sweet snack range.
what_they_do_well: Represents and distributes natural food manufacturers to dietéticas, with advice for new dietética openings.

companies.name: Distribuidora Mayorista Italia
companies.distributes: Alfajores, chocolates, golosinas, biscuits, beverages, gluten-free products, cleaning goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale to trade customers from Villa María, Córdoba province (named retail customers not stated).
companies.sf_brands_carried: Dedicated diet or sugar-free chocolate category including Georgalos sugar-free chocolate; Orieta sugar-free and light jams; Tosti light toasts.
companies.fit_rationale: One of few Córdoba confectionery wholesalers with a dedicated sugar-free chocolate section, proving demand among its trade buyers. Georgalos sugar-free chocolate competes directly, so Diablo would need to win on range breadth and European positioning.
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated diet or sugar-free chocolate category alongside Arcor, Georgalos and Felfort lines.

companies.name: Almacor (cooperative)
companies.distributes: Dry and fresh grocery products purchased and distributed for member almacenes and supermarkets.
companies.channels_supplied: Buying group and distribution centre for associated and non-associated almacenes in Córdoba; also offers cooperative franchises under the Almacor supermarkets name.
companies.fit_rationale: A wholesale buying group founded by Córdoba almaceneros with a 16,000 m2 distribution centre, giving one listing access to many independent stores. Listed head office is Las Peñas while the distribution centre is on the southern access to Córdoba city; to be confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1984 by 13 Córdoba grocers; operates a 16,000 m2 distribution centre since 1996.

companies.name: Supermercados Mayoristas Makro S.A.
companies.distributes: Full cash and carry grocery range including confectionery, snacks, beverages and own brands.
companies.channels_supplied: Professional customers in Córdoba (almacenes and foodservice) via three stores in Córdoba province and the Red M&K almacenero network.
companies.fit_rationale: The leading cash and carry in Córdoba with three stores and an affinity network of almaceneros. Now owned by Cencosud since 2025, which may centralise buying in Buenos Aires.
what_they_do_well: Built the Red M&K network of affiliated almaceneros in Córdoba, reported at 500 members.
Opened a LEED-standard Córdoba store in 2016 on Juan B. Justo and Circunvalación.

companies.name: Distribuidora Amiun S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Golosinas, chocolates and kiosk items, plus some grocery lines.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks and retailers in Córdoba (named customers not stated).
companies.fit_rationale: A long-established Córdoba golosinas and kiosk wholesaler registered in this exact activity since 1993. Kiosk channel reach suits single-serve Diablo bars and sweets.
what_they_do_well: Over 20 years supplying candy and kiosk items in Córdoba, recently moved to a larger facility.

companies.name: Fragueiro S.A. (Distribuidora Fragueiro)
companies.distributes: Groceries, biscuits, golosinas, beverages, cleaning, pet food and batteries.
companies.channels_supplied: More than 1,800 almacenes, autoservicios, kiosks and hardware stores in Córdoba city, Villa Allende, Saldán, La Calera and Malvinas Argentinas, plus its own cash and carry.
companies.fit_rationale: An established Córdoba distributor with its own field sales force reaching most of the city's small retailers. It carries Arcor and Felfort confectionery but no visible sugar-free line, leaving room for Diablo.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1988 with more than 1,800 retail clients in Córdoba.
Eleven sales executives cover about 75% of Córdoba city.

companies.name: La Casa del Kioskero
companies.distributes: Golosinas, chocolates, alfajores, biscuits, snacks, beverages, groceries, perfumery and kiosk sundries.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks and almacenes in Córdoba and nationwide via delivery and two branches (Centro and Jardín).
companies.fit_rationale: A family kiosk wholesaler with two Córdoba branches and delivery to shops. No sugar-free line was seen, so Diablo would be a differentiated addition, though volumes per SKU may be small.
what_they_do_well: Family business with more than 30 years supplying kiosks and almacenes in Córdoba.

companies.name: Supermercados Mayoristas Yaguar S.A.
companies.distributes: Full wholesale grocery range including confectionery, snacks and beverages.
companies.channels_supplied: Supermarkets, convenience stores, kiosks, restaurants and hotels through more than 20 branches including Córdoba.
companies.fit_rationale: A national cash and carry with a Córdoba branch serving neighbourhood trade. Listing would be decided centrally, so it suits a later stage once an importer is in place. Head office location is assumed from its Buenos Aires base and not verified.
what_they_do_well: Says it serves over 75,000 businesses across Argentina, including kiosks and supermarkets.

companies.name: Droguería del Sud S.A.
companies.based_out_of: Juárez Celman, Argentina (Córdoba distribution centre; head office not verified)
companies.distributes: Medicines and pharmacy-related products (food lines not confirmed).
companies.channels_supplied: About 2,000 pharmacies, clinics and health insurers in Córdoba and eight northern provinces.
companies.fit_rationale: Pharmacies are a key channel for diabetic-friendly sweets in Argentina and this droguería reaches 2,000 of them from Córdoba. Whether it handles food or confectionery is not confirmed, so it is conditional.
what_they_do_well: Opened a 16,000 m2 distribution centre near Córdoba in 2025 holding about 25,000 product references.

companies.name: Alonso J. y José A. Redolfi S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Food, refrigerated goods, beverages, cigarettes, cleaning and perfumery.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale self-service stores in San Francisco, Río Tercero and Río Cuarto, plus distribution from James Craik, Córdoba capital and other bases.
companies.fit_rationale: A regional wholesaler with cash and carry outlets and distribution across the Córdoba interior, extending reach beyond the capital. Source is a 2022 university case study, so current scale should be checked.
what_they_do_well: Runs wholesale self-service stores in San Francisco, Río Tercero and Río Cuarto.

companies.name: San Pablo S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Food, beverages, personal care, home care, pet food and stationery.
companies.channels_supplied: Retailers across Córdoba capital, Sierras Chicas, Punilla, Jesús María, Colonia Caroya and northern Córdoba with 24 to 48 hour delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: An official distributor for Unilever, Kimberly Clark and Molino Cañuelas with route coverage of northern Córdoba. Confectionery is not a core line, so Diablo would be a new category for its sales force.
what_they_do_well: Official distributor in Córdoba for Unilever, Kimberly Clark, Grupo Peñaflor and Clorox.

companies.name: MDM Mayorista
companies.distributes: Mass consumption food and grocery products (51 brands).
companies.channels_supplied: More than 1,500 shops in Córdoba capital and nearby towns such as Villa Allende, La Calera, Carlos Paz and Río Ceballos, ordering via app.
companies.fit_rationale: A mid-sized Córdoba wholesaler with an ordering app and over 1,500 retail clients. Brand list is dairy and grocery led, so confectionery fit is unproven.
what_they_do_well: More than 16 years trading with over 1,500 clients, three branches and an 800 m2 distribution centre.

companies.name: Don Emilio S.R.L. (Don Emilio Mayorista)
companies.distributes: Wholesale groceries (detailed range not verified); group also produces dulce de leche.
companies.channels_supplied: Trade buyers in Villa María and surrounding area (details not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: A large Villa María business founded in 1985 that runs a wholesale outlet on the city's southern access. Its range and channels need confirming, so it sits mid-list.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 1985 by the Giraudo brothers of Villa María and now run by the second generation.

companies.name: CordobaFood
companies.distributes: Fresh, dry and canned foods from national brands.
companies.channels_supplied: Foodservice (bars, hotels, restaurants, caterers), supermarkets, autoservicios and almacenes, plus distributors and institutions, in Gran Córdoba, Sierras Chicas, Punilla and the south of the province.
companies.fit_rationale: Mixed retail and foodservice wholesaler with its own refrigerated fleet across Córdoba province. Confectionery is not a visible line, so Diablo would be an add-on.
what_they_do_well: Delivers within 24 to 48 hours across Gran Córdoba with its own refrigerated fleet.

companies.name: Hasta el Cielo
companies.distributes: Bulk candy by weight, gummies, marshmallows, lollipops and party combos.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale buyers with a minimum order and retail customers, shipping nationwide.
companies.fit_rationale: A Córdoba candy wholesaler and retailer focused on gummies and party candy. Sugar-free gummies could fit, but the business is small and part retail.

companies.name: Gianelli Distribuidora Mayorista
companies.distributes: Cold cuts, cheese, dairy, beverages, pantry goods and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Food businesses and retail shoppers via several Córdoba branches including Villa Carlos Paz, with wholesale delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: A multi-branch Córdoba wholesaler but led by fiambres and dairy, so confectionery fit is weak. Branch count is inconsistent on its site.

companies.name: Distribuidora del Centro
companies.distributes: Cigarettes, tobacco, golosinas, snacks, disposables and pantry goods.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks and shops in Córdoba Capital (named customers not stated).
companies.fit_rationale: A Córdoba Capital kiosk wholesaler; directory and social listings only.

companies.name: José Block Distribuciones
companies.distributes: Golosinas and cigarettes (per site title; site could not be read).
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosk trade in Córdoba (not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: Appears to be a golosinas and cigarette distributor in Córdoba; site could not be read, so details are unverified.

companies.name: Vigil y Cía S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Registered as a wholesaler of chocolates, golosinas and kiosk products.
companies.channels_supplied: Not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed first by size among Córdoba-registered golosinas wholesalers and trading since 1967. Activity and location need confirming.

companies.name: Juan Orpi S.A.
companies.distributes: Registered as a wholesaler of chocolates, golosinas and kiosk products.
companies.channels_supplied: Not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: One of the larger Córdoba-registered golosinas wholesalers, incorporated in 1986. Registry listing only.

companies.name: Distrigolo S.A.
companies.distributes: Registered as a wholesaler of chocolates, golosinas and kiosk products.
companies.channels_supplied: Not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: A Córdoba-registered golosinas wholesaler incorporated in 2001. Registry listing only.

companies.name: Sukkar S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Registered as a wholesaler of chocolates, golosinas and kiosk products.
companies.channels_supplied: Not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Appears in both the Córdoba golosinas wholesaler registry and a local trade directory. Both are directory sources, so low confidence.

companies.name: Montecor S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Listed as a golosinas distributor (range not verified).
companies.channels_supplied: Not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed among Córdoba golosinas wholesale distributors in a phone directory only.

companies.name: Mega DAP Distribuidora de Artículos para Kioscos
companies.distributes: Kiosk articles and golosinas (per directory).
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosks in Córdoba (not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: A kiosk-supply distributor in Córdoba city; directory listing only.

companies.name: Distribuidora Margara S.R.L.
companies.distributes: Listed as a golosinas distributor (range not verified).
companies.channels_supplied: Not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Listed among Córdoba golosinas wholesale distributors in two directories; activity not confirmed.

companies.name: Distribuidor Mayorista Rodolfo Manzano
companies.distributes: Cigarettes and golosinas.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosk trade in Río Cuarto (not verified).
companies.fit_rationale: A Río Cuarto cigarette and golosinas wholesaler serving the kiosk channel; directory listing only.

companies.name: EntreSano
companies.distributes: Healthy supermarket: sugar-free, gluten-free and vegan foods, wholegrain bakery, nuts, cereals, supplements and natural cosmetics.
companies.channels_supplied: Own stores in Córdoba city (seven openings by May 2024, one wholesale only) plus own-label yerba mate Entreluna.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free products listed as a core category; specific brands not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: A Córdoba healthy supermarket chain with seven sites that already lists sugar-free as a category and works with around 400 brands, so a curated imported sugar-free range fits its shelf. Its 600 m2 Recta Martinolli store gives room for a branded block.
what_they_do_well: Opened its seventh site, a 600 m2 store on Recta Martinolli, in May 2024 after starting in 2018.
Works with about 400 brands and launched its own yerba mate, Entreluna.

companies.name: Farmacity
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and drugstore: OTC, personal care, beauty and a snack and food aisle.
companies.channels_supplied: 39 stores in Córdoba province (33 in the capital); national chain with beauty arm Get The Look and e-commerce.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest pharmacy chain in Córdoba with 39 stores, and pharmacies are a natural home for diabetic-friendly sweets. A national listing would carry Diablo into every Córdoba store at once.
what_they_do_well: Reached 39 Córdoba stores, up from 25 in 2018, per La Voz.

companies.name: Eneldo
companies.distributes: Natural food market: dried fruit, flours, pulses, keto, vegan, gluten-free and sugar-free products, supplements and natural cosmetics.
companies.channels_supplied: Own stores and franchises across Argentina; first Córdoba franchise in Villa Allende (April 2024).
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free and keto products listed among its 4,000+ items; brands not verified.
companies.fit_rationale: Keto and sugar-free are explicit categories at this growing franchise chain, which opened its first Córdoba province store in Villa Allende. A central buying function across 30+ franchises gives reach beyond Córdoba. Own domain not verified.
what_they_do_well: Grew to 9 own stores and 27 franchises by October 2024, targeting 50.

companies.name: Cencosud Argentina (Disco, Vea, Jumbo)
companies.distributes: Full grocery including confectionery, biscuits and health food aisles.
companies.channels_supplied: Disco (22 stores), Vea (21) and Jumbo (Nuevocentro) in Córdoba as of December 2022; Spid quick commerce via Rappi.
companies.fit_rationale: Around 44 supermarkets in Córdoba across three banners, with Jumbo positioned as the premium format where imported European snacks sit best. A Jumbo listing in Córdoba could extend to the national network later.
what_they_do_well: Runs 22 Disco and 21 Vea stores in Córdoba and opened Jumbo at Nuevocentro in 2022.

companies.name: Carrefour Argentina
companies.distributes: Hypermarkets, supermarkets and Express convenience stores: full grocery and confectionery.
companies.channels_supplied: More than 60 stores in Córdoba province across Hiper, Market, Maxi and Express formats; online store.
companies.fit_rationale: The widest supermarket footprint in Córdoba with 60+ stores, many of them Express convenience units where impulse confectionery sells. The parent rejected sale offers in February 2026 but in August 2026 was again reported to be seeking a buyer or partner, so ownership may change.
what_they_do_well: Opened its 400th Express store nationally in Nueva Córdoba and passed 60 stores in the province.

companies.name: Super Mami (Grupo Dinosaurio)
companies.distributes: Supermarkets and hypermarket: full grocery and confectionery.
companies.channels_supplied: 16 Super Mami stores in Córdoba province after taking over the six A Granel stores in July 2026.
companies.fit_rationale: The fastest-growing Córdoba-owned chain, now 16 stores with more planned in El Tropezón and Villa Carlos Paz. A local head office in Córdoba makes buyer access quicker than national chains.
what_they_do_well: Took over operation of all six A Granel supermarkets in July 2026 under a 20-year agreement.

companies.name: Cordiez
companies.distributes: Neighbourhood supermarkets: full grocery and confectionery; also Mercamax cash and carry stores.
companies.channels_supplied: 39 stores across Córdoba province (plus earlier presence in Catamarca and Santiago del Estero); own delivery fleet.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest Córdoba-born supermarket chain at 39 stores with its own distribution centre and fleet, so it can take product centrally. Its Mercamax cash and carry arm adds a second outlet for the same listing.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1969 from barrio Ferreyra, now 39 stores across the province.
Runs its own 18,000 m2 distribution centre and delivery fleet.

companies.name: La Anónima
companies.distributes: Supermarkets and hypermarkets: full grocery and confectionery.
companies.channels_supplied: Four former Libertad hypermarkets in Córdoba city reopened June 2026; national chain across the interior.
companies.fit_rationale: Newly arrived in Córdoba with four large hypermarkets and actively expanding in the province, so it is building its local range now. Large hypermarket formats have space for a dedicated sugar-free block.
what_they_do_well: Took over 12 Libertad hypermarkets in March 2026 and reopened all four Córdoba stores in June 2026.

companies.name: ChangoMás (Grupo GDN)
companies.distributes: Hypermarkets and supermarkets: full grocery and confectionery.
companies.channels_supplied: Hiper ChangoMás stores in Córdoba (former Walmart) and online store Masonline.
companies.fit_rationale: Operates the former Walmart hypermarkets in Córdoba and sells online through Masonline, giving national e-commerce reach. A value positioning means Diablo would need a price-led entry pack. Córdoba store count not verified.

companies.name: Farmacias Sánchez Antoniolli
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and perfumery: OTC, personal care and health products.
companies.channels_supplied: 24 to 26 pharmacies in Córdoba.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest Córdoba-owned pharmacy chain at about 24 stores, a natural outlet for diabetic-friendly confectionery. Own website not verified.
what_they_do_well: Family business in the Córdoba pharmacy market since 1960, now around 26 branches.

companies.name: FarmaPlus
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and perfumery chain.
companies.channels_supplied: About 87 pharmacies nationally after buying Farmacias Líder (about 20 to 23 Córdoba stores) in 2024.
companies.fit_rationale: Now owns the former Farmacias Líder network in Córdoba, one of the city's top pharmacy chains, plus its own wholesale drugstore. Deal completion was subject to competition approval in 2024; own domain not verified.
what_they_do_well: Agreed to buy Córdoba chain Farmacias Líder in July 2024 for about US$25 million.

companies.name: Mariano Max
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery and confectionery.
companies.channels_supplied: About 11 stores in Córdoba province including Córdoba city, Jesús María and Cruz del Eje.
companies.fit_rationale: A Córdoba-owned supermarket chain of about 11 stores that has shown willingness to give dedicated shelf blocks to themes. Mid-sized buying team should be accessible.
what_they_do_well: Launched a Hecho en Córdoba aisle with more than 1,500 local products.

companies.name: Supermercados Becerra
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery, confectionery and wine.
companies.channels_supplied: 12 to 13 stores in Alta Gracia, Carlos Paz, Calamuchita valley, Despeñaderos and Río Segundo.
companies.fit_rationale: A growing regional chain covering tourist towns such as Villa General Belgrano and Carlos Paz where premium imported snacks sell. Family owned with short decision chains.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1924, from an Alta Gracia greengrocer to 12 supermarkets.

companies.name: Farmacias Red
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and perfumery with online store.
companies.channels_supplied: About 15 pharmacies in Córdoba with expansion to the NEA region; online store.
companies.fit_rationale: A fast-growing Córdoba pharmacy chain with an online store, giving both shelf and e-commerce outlets for sugar-free sweets. Store count varies by source (9 to 15).
what_they_do_well: Doubled its branches in five years and plans more in Córdoba and the NEA.

companies.name: Farmacia General Paz
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and perfumery with online sales.
companies.channels_supplied: About 18 pharmacies in Córdoba; loyalty club.
companies.fit_rationale: One of the largest local pharmacy chains at about 18 stores, with an online store and loyalty club useful for launch promotions.
what_they_do_well: Runs a loyalty club that targeted 40,000 cards.

companies.name: SVfarma
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and perfumery with national e-commerce.
companies.channels_supplied: About 10 pharmacies in Córdoba city and Salsipuedes; online store shipping nationally.
companies.fit_rationale: A growing local pharmacy chain whose e-commerce ships nationwide, so a listing reaches beyond Córdoba. Smaller scale means a quicker decision.
what_they_do_well: Founded in the 1980s in Alta Córdoba and grew to 10 locations by July 2025.

companies.name: PedidosYa Market
companies.distributes: Quick commerce dark stores: about 4,500 grocery items including snacks and beverages.
companies.channels_supplied: Four dark stores in Córdoba city and one in Río Cuarto (May 2025); 69 nationally.
companies.fit_rationale: Owns its stock in Córdoba dark stores open until 23:00, suited to impulse snacking. Head office location stated as PedidosYa group base and not verified for the Argentine unit.
what_they_do_well: Grew to 69 dark stores in 12 provinces since launching in April 2020.

companies.name: Almacor
companies.distributes: Franchised neighbourhood supermarkets: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: More than 70 franchised supermarkets in 46 towns across Córdoba, Santiago del Estero, La Rioja, Catamarca, San Luis and Santa Cruz.
companies.fit_rationale: A wide franchised network across Córdoba towns gives reach into the interior through one central function. Value positioning; head office city assumed Córdoba and not verified.
what_they_do_well: Opened a 468 m2 store in Calchín in September 2025, part of 70+ locations.

companies.name: Caracol Supermercados
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: About 10 stores in Río Tercero, Oliva, Embalse, Almafuerte and Hernando; own distribution centre.
companies.fit_rationale: A family chain of about 10 stores in the Calamuchita and Tercero Arriba area, including tourist towns, with its own distribution centre.
what_they_do_well: Grew from a 1973 deli in Río Tercero to around 10 supermarkets.

companies.name: Supermercados Top (Superimperio)
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery, rotisserie and meat.
companies.channels_supplied: 17 stores in Córdoba province and its zone of influence, five in Río Cuarto.
companies.fit_rationale: The leading chain in Río Cuarto, Córdoba's second city, with 17 stores. Relationship between the Top and Superimperio names is not fully clear from sources.
what_they_do_well: Opened its fifth Río Cuarto store, the 17th in the region, adding 100 staff.

companies.name: HP Farma
companies.distributes: Pharmacy and perfumery.
companies.channels_supplied: About 13 pharmacies in Córdoba owned by Hospital Privado.
companies.fit_rationale: Hospital-linked pharmacy chain of about 13 stores whose patient base includes people managing diabetes. Mainly a dispensing business, so snacks may be a small range.

companies.name: YPF (YPF Full convenience stores)
companies.distributes: Fuel station convenience stores: snacks, confectionery, drinks and coffee.
companies.channels_supplied: 127 YPF stations in Córdoba province (2017), many with Full shops.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest forecourt network in Córdoba, strong for single-serve bars and sweets. Buying is national and convenience ranges are tight; Full shop count in Córdoba not verified.

companies.name: Axion Energy (Spot convenience stores)
companies.distributes: Fuel station convenience stores: snacks, sandwiches and drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: Spot stores at Córdoba stations including Villa Allende and Córdoba city.
companies.fit_rationale: Has been upgrading Spot stores in Córdoba with partner food concepts, suggesting openness to new ranges. Small store count in Córdoba.
what_they_do_well: Opened two Spot stores in Villa Allende and Córdoba city with chef partnership in 2023.

companies.name: Shell Argentina (Raízen, Shell Select stores)
companies.distributes: Fuel station convenience stores: snacks, confectionery and drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: 61 Shell stations in Córdoba province (2017).
companies.fit_rationale: Second largest forecourt network in Córdoba with high volume per station. Select shop presence in Córdoba not verified; buying is national.

companies.name: Hipermercado Anselmi
companies.distributes: Hypermarket: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Hypermarket in San Francisco plus Norte Express store.
companies.fit_rationale: The dominant local grocer in San Francisco, the main city of eastern Córdoba. Small number of stores limits reach.

companies.name: Supermercados Chapulín
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Five stores in the San Francisco and Frontera area (2018).
companies.fit_rationale: A regional chain serving San Francisco, Córdoba, from neighbouring Frontera. Value positioning and dated store data.

companies.name: Supermercados Nexo
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Stores in Corral de Bustos, Monte Maíz and Justiniano Posse.
companies.fit_rationale: A small multi-town chain in south-east Córdoba. Only one press mention found; head office assumed from first listed town.

companies.name: Supermercados Granja
companies.distributes: Supermarkets: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Stores in Río Segundo and Pilar.
companies.fit_rationale: A two-town chain east of Córdoba city. Only one press mention found; head office assumed.

companies.name: Super Festival
companies.distributes: Supermarket: full grocery.
companies.channels_supplied: Store or stores in Cosquín, Punilla valley tourist area.
companies.fit_rationale: Serves the Punilla tourist corridor where visitors buy snacks. Store count unknown; only one press mention found.

companies.name: Farmacias Grassi
companies.distributes: Pharmacy network.
companies.channels_supplied: Pharmacies based in Río Cuarto.
companies.fit_rationale: Named by La Voz as a pharmacy network based in the interior of the province, giving reach in Río Cuarto. Store count not verified.

companies.name: Red Sarmiento
companies.distributes: Pharmacy network.
companies.channels_supplied: Pharmacies in Gran Córdoba.
companies.fit_rationale: A pharmacy network in Gran Córdoba named by La Voz. Store count and buying structure not verified.
